title: Cargo AI explicit profile context refresh payload v1
$comment: Successful profile refresh-context data only. Explicit enrollment/recovery is idempotent for demonstrably unchanged context. UUID and generation are opaque selectors, not credential fingerprints or permission. Consent does not expire with elapsed time. Account public-key evidence may require explicit renewal before execution; credential expiry and capability readiness remain separate. Use profile validate-context with the expected reference for routine continuity checks.
